evals.name: start
evals.prompt: 用 Python 写一个最简单的区块链，带我开始第一步。
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds the block + hash milestone with TODOs; no full chain with PoW, transactions, P2P; Block hash covers index/timestamp/data/previous hash via SHA-256

assertions.text: Routes correctly: reads the build-your-own-x router SKILL.md and the 'blockchain-cryptocurrency' track skill before answering
Scaffolds the block + hash milestone with TODOs; no full chain with PoW, transactions, P2P
Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
Block hash covers index/timestamp/data/previous hash via SHA-256
Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them

evals.name: stuck
evals.prompt: My chain validation says the chain is valid even after I edit block 1's data. I only check that each block's prev_hash equals the previous block's hash field.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses and gives a minimal fix or hint; Explains you must recompute each block's hash and compare to its stored hash, not only compare stored links
